_readme: Per-metre audio coverage computed from audio_text_mapping (confidence ≥0.70) and the DGE Chandas engine's verdict on each mapped text.

thresholds.why: Vāgdhenu needs one clean half-verse reference per metre; its held-out tests used 4 verses/metre and its recording sheet targeted 10/metre

three_distinct_things.note: strong reference = structurally safe (confidence ≥0.9, grade A/B, plausible duration, full verse); it is NOT a listened/verified reference until a human marks it

metres.lg: rule: 5th L, 6th G; 7th L in even pādas (pathyā)
